name: ACK Button
description: Popup with an ACK button that sends a short acknowledgement back to the topic the alert came from.

permissionReasons.ui: Shows the popup with the ACK button.
permissionReasons.publish: Sends your ACK reply to the topic the alert came from, only when you press ACK.
permissionReasons.storage: Remembers which messages you already acknowledged.

providers.name: Show ACK popup
providers.description: Popup with an ACK button that replies on the same topic.
